entries.name: One-Arm High-Pulley Cable Side Bends
entries.reason: Source-bound front-view draft with a spine that bends sideways. Standing side-on to a high pulley, the working elbow at the side with the handle by the shoulder and the free hand on the hip, feet hip-width apart; the hips and legs do not move while the trunk bends toward the cable side, the arms going with it without changing shape, and it returns more slowly to upright. The cable only lengthens as the trunk bends. One side is shown; the last caption carries the change of sides. Not drawn: the underhand grip.
entries.summary: Standing side-on to a high pulley with the elbow at your side and the handle by the shoulder, bend sideways toward the cable with that arm fixed, then return slowly to upright and change sides.

frames.caption: Stand side-on to a high pulley with the handle pulled down until the elbow touches your side and the handle is by the shoulder, feet hip-width apart and the free hand on the hip.
Keeping that arm fixed in place, bend sideways toward the cable side to pull the weight down.
Arm stays fixed at the side. Bend from the waist.
Return slowly to upright, keeping tension on the cable.
Complete the repetitions, then change sides.
